facts.fact: The UPPC article says the Integrated Revenue Administration System (IRAS) is in use in 98 districts, 21 municipalities and 9 cities for budgeting, revenue collection and accounting, at a total investment of UGX 20.07 billion.
The UPPC article counts IRAS as implemented in 98 districts, 21 municipalities and 9 cities, 128 local governments in all.

The article says the Ministry of Local Government rolled out the E-LogRev local government revenue management system, deployed in 48 local governments, and the Auditor General reports local revenue rising from UGX 21.63 billion to 34.17 billion in those from 2019/20 to 2022/23.
The Ministry of Local Government says E-LogRev is deployed in 48 local governments.
The Ministry of Local Government rolled out E-LogRev, the local government revenue management integrated system.
